propositions: Build a Data Center transport on pycontribs/jira that satisfies TicketTransport role plus SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe, confined to an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra and imported lazily so rebar stays dependency-free.
Auth via Personal Access Token from JIRA_PAT env var passed as token_auth; config from [tool.rebar.jira] fails loudly on malformation rather than degrading to env-only.
Every transport method returns raw payload shapes (dicts) that existing mappers already consume, not jira.Issue objects, with retry/timeout/error mapping onto rebar's transport contract.

TLS validation rejects non-https URLs with ConfigError unless allow_insecure=true; certificate verification is never disabled; ca_bundle configures internal CAs; resolved_statuses defaults to {Resolved, Done, Cancelled} for DC absence probe.
Self-registration import in adapters/__init__.py must be added so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves at runtime via _backend_registry lookup.
Live NameIdentity user-search resolver wired through search_users lookup on DC instance, returning authoritative identity for real users and raising BackendAssigneeNotFoundError for unknown ones.
